finding.text: reviewer failed to run: The operation was aborted due to timeout

Build step 1 (group in `file()`) is not in the diff: `Server/PromptRecords.mjs` is unchanged on worktree/qf-8 (`git log -- Server/PromptRecords.mjs` ends at ff59564aa), and `file()` at Server/PromptRecords.mjs:181-205 still adds one root `tasks.add` per ask. Commit 34efefc58 says "a prompt's asks file as subtasks of one outcome task" but it only adds `Server/PromptGroup.test.mjs`.

Build step 3 (the `attach_to` Haiku match) is missing too: no `attach_to` method exists anywhere in PromptRecords.mjs. The test stubs `pr.attach_to` (Server/PromptGroup.test.mjs:23,40), but nothing calls it.

Build step 2 is not done. `task_state()` (Server/PromptRecords.mjs:209-211) only maps ids from top-level `l.tasks.add`, so a nested `{"<parent>":{"tasks":{"add":…}}}` subtask resolves to null. Nothing extends the scan for subtasks, and nothing checks `sweep()` for parents.
The new test fails. `node Server/PromptGroup.test.mjs` throws `AssertionError: a 3-ask prompt gives ONE root task, titled from its subject` at line 27. It was committed red.

`public/framework/core/Session/doc/prompt-breakdown.md` describes the grouping, attach_to and subtask resolution as if they were live. They are not. The readme line (core/Session/readme.md:103) and the prompt-tasks.md:39 link repeat the claim, so a fresh agent reading the docs would believe the feature has shipped.

The branch carries an unrelated commit, 56e6182ae "context alerts" (Servex/agents/Agents.js `context_alert`, Follow.js POINTER `alert:`, context-alert.test.mjs, ai/doc/context.md). The brief never asked for it, and merging this task would land it unreviewed under the wrong task name. Split it onto its own branch or task.

A fresh agent cannot continue from the task folder alone. It holds no task.jsonl, no report, no before/after numbers and no ready-to-merge statement (the brief asks for them), and review.jsonl only records the earlier reviewer timeout.

`Server/prompt-group-dry.mjs` does not replay the `prompts.jsonl` parts the way step 4 asks. It counts existing root `tasks.add` per prompt and sets "after" to the prompt count by definition, so it cannot see caps, rules, or prompts whose asks were never filed. Its result (81 prompts, 279 → 81) differs from the brief's 341/87, and the doc's reason ("older-format sources") is unverified: `from_prompt` already accepts `prompt:` string sources (PromptRecords.mjs:38).

The test's scratch folder sits inside the real sessions tree (`public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/25/.prompt-group-test-<pid>`, PromptGroup.test.mjs:11). The `finally` removes it, but a watcher or indexer may see it mid-run, so `os.tmpdir()` is safer if PromptRecords accepts an outside folder.

`public/framework/core/Session/files.jsonl` gains `failures.jsonl` and `tasks/` "gone" lines, which have nothing to do with this task, and `tasks/` and `session-task.test.mjs` were already listed twice. This is index churn from a census run and is worth dropping from the diff.
Step 5's tab check is answered reasonably: prompt-relay.mjs runs before filing, so it documents the gap rather than building the line. Keep that once the feature exists.
